verdict.rationale: Mem0's entity-scoped memory docs say the Platform API separates memories by user, agent, and app, and can also scope by session so memories 'land exactly where they belong'. The quickstart shows user_id scoping on add calls. The self-hosted bundle adds per-user API keys and a request audit log. Missing for 10: documentation that isolation is enforced at retrieval (rather than relying on the caller passing the right IDs), details on how search filters by scope, and independent or hands-on confirmation that scoped retrieval never leaks across tenants.
